Ligue Magnus shootout attempts

Source: R/magnus.R
magnus_shootout.Rd

Shootout attempts from the game sheet, in round order: shootout_round is the round (one attempt per team per round), not a jersey number. Trailing rounds that were not needed are listed with no shooter and scored NA. Zero rows when the game had no shootout.

Usage

magnus_shootout(game_id, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

game_id

Game id (game_id of magnus_schedule()), e.g. 77779 (2026-27, shootout and MVPs); also sampled: 68838, 865.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE). Pass FALSE for the game sheet extracted from the page's embedded JSON, as a list.

Value

A tibble (return_parsed = TRUE; zero rows without a shootout), else the game sheet list:

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerGame id (integer join key).
attempt_idintegerShootout attempt id (integer).
shootout_roundintegerShootout round of the attempt (one attempt per team per round); not a jersey number.
team_idintegerTeam id of the shooting team (integer).
team_abbreviationcharacterAbbreviation of the shooting team.
shooter_player_idintegerPerson id of the shooter (integer); null on rounds not needed.
shooter_namecharacterName of the shooter.
goalie_player_idintegerPerson id of the goalie facing the attempt (integer).
goalie_namecharacterName of the goalie facing the attempt.
scoredlogicalWhether the attempt scored; null on rounds not needed.

Errors

As magnus_competitions().

See also

Other Ligue Magnus Functions: magnus_competitions(), magnus_game(), magnus_lineups(), magnus_pbp(), magnus_phases(), magnus_round_games(), magnus_rounds(), magnus_schedule(), magnus_standings(), magnus_teams()

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(magnus_shootout(game_id = 77779))
#> ── Ligue Magnus Shootout Information from liguemagnus.com ──────────────────────
#> ℹ Data updated: 2026-10-30 00:17:14 UTC
#> # A tibble: 10 × 10
#>    game_id attempt_id shootout_round team_id team_abbreviation shooter_player_id
#>      <int>      <int>          <int>   <int> <chr>                         <int>
#>  1   77779      33605              1     553 ANG                           39651
#>  2   77779      33606              1    3409 BRI                          143117
#>  3   77779      33607              2     553 ANG                           99599
#>  4   77779      33608              2    3409 BRI                           54923
#>  5   77779      33609              3     553 ANG                          120435
#>  6   77779      33610              3    3409 BRI                          142947
#>  7   77779      33611              4     553 ANG                          120499
#>  8   77779      33612              4    3409 BRI                           69022
#>  9   77779      33613              5     553 ANG                              NA
#> 10   77779      33614              5    3409 BRI                              NA
#> # ℹ 4 more variables: shooter_name <chr>, goalie_player_id <int>,
#> #   goalie_name <chr>, scored <lgl>
# }
